rca of the issue: POST /api/setup/admin returned 500. RCA: motor's insert_one mutates the input dict by adding MongoDB _id (ObjectId), which is not JSON-serializable. The endpoint returned the mutated user dict directly, causing FastAPI response serialization to fail with 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. Fix: user.pop('_id', None) after insert_one, consistent with how POST /api/auth/login already handles this. Reproduction: fresh DB, POST /api/setup/admin with valid payload → 500. After fix: 200 with {user, access_token}.
